description: Send stock back to a supplier against a closed purchase order — the purchase order's Create supplier return. Each line names the purchase order line (or SKU) and how many units go back, at most what was received minus what is already on a supplier return. issue=true (default) also issues it like a sales order (it may wait for approval); it is then picked, packed and shipped out with pick_items, pack_items and ship_out, which takes the units out of stock. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

issue.description: true (default) issues the return for picking; false leaves it created.

lineId.description: The order line to return (GUID): a sales order line id from get_sales_order for a customer return, a purchase order line id from get_purchase_orders for a supplier return. Either lineId or sku is required.

quantity.description: Units to return, in the line's unit of measure (> 0).

reason.description: Optional reason, shown on the return line.

sku.description: Item SKU on the order; must match exactly one line.

note.description: Optional internal note on the return.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

purchaseOrderId.description: Purchase order id (GUID) or number from get_purchase_orders.

storeId.description: Optional store id (GUID) from list_warehouses the return ships from; defaults to the store of the purchase order's warehouse.

name: create_supplier_return
title: Create Supplier Return
